abstract: The VIENNAVARS project investigates the early medieval Avar-period cemetery of Vienna 11-Csokorgasse, the largest known early medieval burial ground in the Vienna metropolitan area. It combines bioarchaeological skeletal analysis with studies of material culture and spatial visualization to reconstruct female lifeworlds, health status, and social stratification during the 7th and 8th centuries AD. Datasets are permanently archived via PHAIDRA and curated under controlled scientific access in compliance with Wien Museum intellectual property rights.
